items.title: Weakly crepant categorical resolutions of general Coble cubics from isotropic flag geometry
items.difficulty_reason: H3: the author does not merely invoke a categorical resolution criterion on a supplied blow-up. The complete core constructs a smooth flag-variety resolution of the Coble cubic from a general auxiliary skew form, analyses its three fiber strata and rational singularities, resolves the exceptional center through a nonsemisimple homogeneous-bundle Koszul/Bott calculation and an adjoint contraction, and identifies the nested normal bundles and exact canonical discrepancy. These geometric data then feed the supplied jumping-projective-fiber semiorthogonal framework and its tautological-quotient specialization to produce the conormal Lefschetz decomposition required by the explicitly cited Kuznetsov criterion. The resulting admissible right orthogonal is proved weakly crepant; stronger curve-component or rectangular decompositions remain conjectural. This integrated singular-geometry/derived-category construction is a research-level obligation, with cited input criteria retained rather than assistant-proved.
